Let's add the diameter of each type of cell.

$\phantom{=}\blueD{5.1\cdot10^{-4}}+8.0\cdot10^{-3}$

Let's start by converting the diameter of the body cell so that it has the same power of $10$ as the diameter of the plant cell.

$\begin{align}\blueD{5.1\cdot10^{-4}} &= (\blueD{5.1\cdot 10^{-1}})\cdot 10^{-3}\\
\\
&=\blueD{0.51\cdot10^{-3}}
\end{align}$
The combined diameter of the plant and body cell is $=8.51\cdot10^{-3}\text{ cm}$.

question.content:
The average human body cell is about $5.1 \cdot 10^{-4} \text{ cm}$ in diameter.  The diameter of a plant cell is $8 \cdot 10^{-3} \text { cm}$.

**What is the combined diameter of the body cell and plant cell?**  
*Express your answer in scientific notation.*

[[☃ expression 1]] $\text{ cm}$
